What you'll do End-to-End Segment Ownership: Own the digital client lifecycle from Lead → Signup → Checkout → First Investment → Activation → Expansion. You define the segment's North Star and KPI tree across conversion and expansion – lead-to-funded conversion, time to fund, time to first top-up, multi-product rate, share of wallet – and you are accountable for net new money from the segment, not for a single funnel stage. You shape the first-product strategy – which entry offer converts which persona – and make sure the brand promise and premium positioning carry through every step that builds trust and drives conversion. Digital Up- & Cross-Sell: Turn first-time investors into multi-product clients: top-ups and savings plans, second portfolios, additional account types and access to new asset classes such as private markets. You find natural product sequences through path and cohort analysis, build the in-product moments and lifecycle campaigns that convert them, and prove impact with causal measurement rather than correlation stories. title: SQL Developer – AI Prompting & Context Engineering
description: This is a dual role, split between approximately 60% AI-assisted development and agent orchestration, and 40% SQL Server development supporting large-scale data migration. You’ll work within the development team and report to the Software Manager, combining practical AI skills with strong SQL expertise to deliver reliable, efficient solutions. Key Responsibilities AI-Assisted Development & Agent Orchestration (c. 60%) Use AI coding assistants, such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot, across the development lifecycle, including code generation, refactoring, testing, documentation and review. Build and maintain effective prompts, system instructions, reusable skills and context to produce consistent, reliable AI outputs. Design and orchestrate agents and multi-agent workflows, including task decomposition, tool use, agent hand-offs and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Connect agents to internal systems, databases and APIs, for example through MCP or function calling. Evaluate AI output for accuracy, regression, cost and latency, and refine workflows based on results. Apply appropriate safeguards for data privacy, security and hallucination risk, particularly when customer or school data is involved. Identify and prototype opportunities to apply AI to development and data migration, and share best practice by supporting and coaching colleagues. SQL Server & Data Migration (c. 40%) Design, develop and maintain scalable SQL Server T-SQL solutions and related tools for data cleansing, migration and reconciliation. Provide database performance-tuning expertise for internal and third-party systems, using AI tooling where appropriate. Define technical requirements with non-technical colleagues in the Data Migration Team, and work with third parties to understand their software and support migration projects. Manage SQL Server database environments used for data migration, including backup and recovery in test environments. Prepare and expose data safely for agents and AI workflows, using AI to support SQL query generation, code review and optimisation. title: Pre-Sales / Sales Engineer
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ The Pre-Sales role ⭐️ Our Pre-Sales team strengthens Alan’s Enterprise and Public sector Sales to better handle the specificities of our largest customers. Here are the main missions of the team you will join: Master our platform and support Sales team by enabling them with insights, expertise and the relevant tools; Listen and understand prospects’ needs and work internally on how Alan can address them best; Build a thorough understanding of the prospect and assess the level of functional alignment with our offering and capabilities; Participate to RFP submissions and build Alan’s response in collaboration with Sales, Insurance and Product experts; Join the customer acquisition journey to evangelize our services and products; Act as voice of the customer feeding Alan’s platform roadmap; Prepare handover for delightful customers’ onboardings; Eventually coordinate the most complex customer onboardings leveraging your unique knowledge of the customer’s requirements and specificities. You will actively participate in developing this growing function within Alan and edit the company to make our Sales teams the most successful of all! Given the growing need for onsite customer engagement, this role requires you to be based in Paris or the Île-de-France region (or within a 2-hour door to door distance with the flexibility to travel to Paris on short notice for customer meetings). For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-E level range . ⭐️ You will be a great fit if ⭐️ You have 6+ years of experience working in a SaaS environment, including at least 3 in a Pre-Sales / Sales Engineering / Solution Consultant role. You have a talent for quickly getting to the root cause of customers concern through active listening and requirements elicitation; You are assertive and know how to handle objections in a complex environment; You master the art of pitching a product with transparency and without overselling its capabilities ; You have the ability to break down complex issues and identify product gaps to define the best product solutions; You thrive at high level stakeholders’ management; You excel at prioritizing tasks while living up to commitments; You love teamwork and are always eager to learn and grow; You are fluent in both French and English; It would be even better if you have: Experience with end-to-end procurement projects (buyer or supplier side) with involvement in RFI’s, RFQ’s and RFP’s; Experience in the French Public Sector ; Experience in HRIS ecosystems and Payroll solutions ; Experience in Insurance or Health platforms . 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

title: Product Builder - Mo (AI health companion)
description: 🤖 Who we are We’re building Mo — a health companion for everyone. We’re a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise . We are building Mo, an intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care. Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise - through chat, voice, or video. That’s what we are building 🤖. We kicked off the project in 2023, and we have launched Mo to all our french members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe. 🚀 Why we need you Mo’s scope is expanding fast: inside Alan (a new Clinic, new capabilities), across the countries we operate in, and at the interfaces with many other Alan experiences. To get this expansion right, and to keep ownership distributed within the team, we’re looking for a Product Builder to take on a real share of that complexity and ambiguity. You’ll own end-to-end one slice of Mo’s product scope. Depending on your profile, it could be: 🩺 Mo for reactive care. Build all the integrations between Mo, our Clinic and the healthcare system, and shape how our medical team interacts with members in and through Mo. 🛡️ Mo for insurance. Make Mo the main interface between members and Alan, building on our Support AI agents, across channels and countries. 🌍 Mo global. Adapt Mo to new countries and find the right operating model for each (medical reviews, safety, local features). ➕ Mo as a platform. Make Mo the companion other teams build upon, so our domain experts can ship their own experiences through it. 🎯 Is it you we’re looking for? We’re looking for Product Builders with around 5+ years of experience who want to build state-of-the-art AI products and apply them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare. You’ll own a product area end-to-end: problem framing, vision, prioritisation, shipping, and measuring whether we actually help members get and stay better. You’ll work daily with engineers, ML engineers, data, and doctors, at the frontier of LLMs and agentic systems, and see your work in production with real people. You’ll navigate ambiguity and many stakeholders across Alan, and turn it into clear decisions and a focused roadmap. You’ll be hands-on: prototyping, digging into data, reading conversations and evals, getting into the technical details with the team. You’ll contribute to our product culture and help build the team (hiring, interview loops, etc.). You would be a good fit in Mo if most of this sounds like you: Experience building and shipping a live AI/LLM product Very hands-on, comfortable with technical and data topics (SQL, prototyping, understanding how an LLM system behaves and fails) Interest or experience in one or several medical or prevention themes Product-minded and outcome-driven: you care about impact, not output Self-directed, pragmatic, driven, hard working Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!) Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching Fluent in English Ex-engineers and ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus 🤘 How we do it ? We benefit from Alan’s platform , infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise — but operate with the speed and focus of a startup. If you’re curious about Alan’s broader vision, our Shareholder Letters are worth a read. People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as: How we work: our Leadership Principles Mission is the Boss — We think long-term and are methodical optimists who take risks, seeking our mission's success above all else. Distributed Ownership — Accountable enlightened

To succeed, you will have to (1) articulate a vision for your segment, (2) define priorities and resources to deliver, and (3) make strategic decisions for your segment based on market insights. The Business Segment Lead role is made for transversal influence as we operate based on distributed ownership. You will work closely with all teams involved in the success of your segment (Product, Insurance, Sales, Marketing). You’ll relentlessly ask yourself: what is the best product offering to become leader in this segment? Go-to-Market strategy: You’ll work both on renewal (account management) and expansion strategy (business development). This will require you to adapt and innovate when it comes to distribution channels, sub-segments, and partners management. P&L ownership & Resources allocation: You’ll own the return on investment of your segment and are in charge of building the case for internal resources allocation based on your P&L. Product trade-off: You’ll work together with product teams in order for us to build the best product based on market insights. We are currently hiring for new segments: It gathers several, high potential sub-segments where everything is to be built.
